title: Fire-Boltt Rise Force Smart Watch 1.85” Display, Nylon–Fluoroelastomer Hybrid Strap, Rotating Crown, Bluetooth Calling, Dual Button Control, Metal Body Smartwatch for Men and Women Sandstone
bullets: Large 1.85” Display for Maximum Visibility - Fire-Boltt Rise Force features a 1.85 inch display that offers a bold viewing experience with easy readability for workouts, calls and daily use.

Nylon–Fluoroelastomer Hybrid Strap for Rugged Use - Built with a nylon–fluoroelastomer hybrid strap, Fire-Boltt Rise Force offers superior durability, flexibility and sweat resistance. The tough nylon exterior ensures long-lasting strength, while the fluoroelastomer lining provides comfort, grip and resistance to wear during workouts and outdoor use.
Rotating Crown for Smooth Navigation - The rotating crown allows effortless scrolling and precise control, enhancing usability during workouts and everyday activities.
Dual Button Functionality for Quick Access - Designed with dual button controls, Rise Force offers fast access to key features and improved control during active use.
High Durability Build for Active Lifestyles - Built with high-durability construction, this smartwatch is designed to handle daily wear, workouts and outdoor activities with confidence

Bluetooth Calling with In-Built Mic & Speaker - Make and receive calls directly from your wrist using Bluetooth calling, powered by an in-built microphone and speaker for clear, hands-free communication.
Voice Assistant for Smart Control - Use the voice assistant to set reminders, check information and perform tasks quickly, keeping your hands free.
Smart Notifications Stay Connected - Receive call alerts, WhatsApp, SMS and app notifications directly on your wrist so you stay updated without reaching for your phone.
